editorial:
Imagine you are feeling totally burnt out by your job and your dating life. That is exactly where you find the two main women in this story. They are best friends living in Berlin who are just tired of the same old routine and the men who let them down. You will feel like you are just hanging out with them as they decide to stop following the rules and start living for themselves. It is a very relaxed, slice-of-life kind of story that feels more like a real memory than a scripted movie. You get to see the city through their eyes during a hot summer, making the whole experience feel warm and authentic.

What really makes this work is how natural the acting feels. It does not feel like they are reading lines; it feels like they are actually talking. While the pace is slow and there are no big explosions or crazy plot twists, the small moments are what stay with you. If you like movies that focus on friendship and real-life struggles, you will love this. Just keep in mind it is a slow burn, so settle in with some snacks and take your time with it.
endingExplained: By the end, you see the women realize that while they cannot fix everything in their lives, they have each other. They do not find a magical solution to their money or relationship problems, but they find peace in their friendship. The movie wraps up with them accepting their flaws and choosing to stay positive. It ends on a hopeful note, showing that having a true friend is more important than having a perfect life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves realistic stories about friendship and adult life.
